proof.pattern: kill-switch fills: order [0-9a-f-]+ validated across [0-9]+ fills today .*change=kill-partial-1104

expected_rate: one line per order that fills in two or more pieces on a trading day (stops and limit orders on thin moves); several sessions have none
window_reason: multi-piece fills are occasional (XOM 11-04, NVDA Day orders 11-05 filled 1+1 and 3+1); ten sessions normally include at least one
reversal: a 'kill-switch fill/order facts mismatch' line for an order whose FILL activities are a consistent cum_qty sequence, a kill snapshot with attribution_exact false caused by a multi-piece fill, or any session where the exact measure shows a smaller Day+Swing loss than the fills imply

metrics.name: false fill/order mismatch degradations
metrics.source: logs/mtf_bot.log 'facts mismatch' lines with change=kill-partial-1104, checked against the order's FILL activities

baseline_exempt_reason: the 'validated across N fills today [change=kill-partial-1104]' line is new in this change, so a match can only come from the new code
